name: King County Democrats
lean_basis: Official county Democratic Party organization. Its homepage: 'We are a community of Democrats across 17 Legislative Districts, working together to elect progressive leaders' (https://www.kcdems.org/).

name: King County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county Republican Party organization. Its guide says picks were made 'to represent our voters on issues like taxes and public safety,' with input from its 17 legislative district organizations (https://kcgop.org/votersguide/).

name: MLK Labor (Martin Luther King, Jr. County Labor Council)
lean_basis: Our reading of its stated mission: "to unify all labor organizations in King County to build power and strength for all workers,". Source: https://www.mlklabor.org/about/.

name: Seattle Metropolitan Chamber of Commerce (CASE PAC)
lean_basis: Our reading of its stated mission: "a thriving community depends on vibrant business". Source: https://www.seattlechamber.com/about/.

name: Fuse Washington (Progressive Voters Guide)
lean_basis: Its stated mission or political identity includes: "Join the largest progressive organization in Washington". Source: https://fusewashington.org/.
